contexts.text: He loosed the camels () = freedom for these things... To loose = to make free.
After the loosing from the body. HH 355:end. HH 434:end. HH 456.
The interiors fully open and unloosed...
All the inner tissues would be broken down.
Loose the four Angels () = that external bonds may be taken away from them. AE 569.
To open and shut Heaven, or to loose and bind, thus to forgive sins...
He must be loosed a little time () = that those meant by the dragon are to be loosed for a short time, and communication with the others is to be opened to them.
Satan shall be loosed out of his prison () = that all those who had confirmed falsities of faith in themselves were let out.
To loose the seals of the book () = to know and perceive the states of life of all.
Whatever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in the Heavens (). Explained. AE 820:4.
The four Angels were loosed = the licence to reason from fallacies.
I have not come to loose the Law ().
